type: Architecture comparison plus local deterministic TypeScript mechanism diagnostic, not a model benchmark
backend: open-source LSP only; JetBrains described from source/docs, not executed
cases: exported function references with renamed import alias and unrelated homonym/string/comment
semantic cross-file rename preserving unrelated identifiers and literals, then real compiler validation
correct prior symbol-body retrieval followed by external source change: compare stale-content handling if full Serena tool execution is available
expectedReferenceIdentity: consumer import and aliased call refer to original exported symbol; unrelated declaration/call/string/comment do not
method: Freeze fixture and expected identity before calls; preserve whole returned results, setup failures/timeouts, exact source hashes and compiler exit. Light lexical hits are candidates, not asserted semantic references. Manual Light patch targets are explicitly human-selected; do not count that selection as native rename support. Byte/call counts are mechanism diagnostics, never billed tokens or model success.
limitations: Small fixed diagnostic, unblinded manual architecture reading. No head-to-head model success/token/cost/cached-duration claims, no JetBrains runtime or crash-atomicity proof.
